summary.en: A line bound to a time track: each word fills with the accent as it is read, a reading bar under it; or every character swells bold on the beat and springs back thin.
summary.zh: 文字绑在时间轴上：读到哪个词，哪个词就从左到右填亮、下面跟一条读指；或每个字在鼓点上笔画撑粗再弹回，最后一拍落成粗体。

fits: Text that keeps time with the sound: fill for a line said by the voice-over or sung, read at its pace; pump for one short word on the beat of the music before a drop.
notFor: Silent passages (fill then reads as a random colour change, pump as a twitch); fill on more than two rows or six words a screen; pump on a word over about 8 characters (4 in Chinese), or more than one pump passage a film.

intent.en: The text keeps time with the sound: fill leads the eye word by word with the voice, pump makes the beat visible in the strokes.
intent.zh: 文字跟着声音走：fill 随旁白一个词一个词牵着视线，pump 让鼓点在笔画上看得见。

content.en: fill: a line of up to six words (two rows at most) and its reading times, or a voice-over track to time it from; pump: one short word (≤ 8 chars) and the beats.
content.zh: fill：一句话，最多六个词、两行，加上每个词的朗读时间（或据以计时的旁白音轨）；pump：一个短词（≤ 4 字）和拍点。

fits.zh: 跟着声音走的字：fill 用在旁白念出或唱出的一句话上，按语速填色；pump 用在 drop 前随鼓点跳动的一个短词上。

notFor.zh: 无声段落（fill 读作莫名变色，pump 读作抽风）；fill 超过两行或一屏六个词；pump 用在超过约 8 个字符（中文 4 字）的词上，或一支片不止一段 pump。

pairs.note: bring the line on with blur, then let it read along

en: Both ways depend on sound: pump hits must land on the drum frame, fill windows must follow the voice's word boundaries.
pump needs a variable font; without one the weight jumps in steps.
One pump passage a film; it steals every scene it is in.
zh: 两式都强依赖声音：pump 命中帧要和鼓点同帧，fill 的填色区间要跟旁白的词边界。
pump 需要可变字体，没有就退成几档跳变。
pump 一支片只用一段，它抢戏。
